tagline: Track books on your shelves and who has borrowed them
summary: A single-record-type browser app for cataloguing books at home. Each book has a title, author, and category. You can mark a book as lent to someone and clear that when it comes back. The list shows everything you own, with a filter for books currently out and a count of how many are lent.

stats.label: Lent out
stats.rule: count of rows where borrower is not empty

journeys.title: adds a book and shows it in the list
journeys.steps: Open the app; press Add; enter Title, Author, choose Category; save.
journeys.expect: The new book appears in the list with its Title, Author, and Category.

journeys.title: rejects an empty required field
journeys.steps: Press Add; leave Title empty; save.
journeys.expect: The form shows 'Title is required' and does not save.

journeys.title: edits an existing book
journeys.steps: Open a book; press Edit; change Title; save.
journeys.expect: The book's Title is updated in the list.

journeys.title: deletes a book added by mistake
journeys.steps: Open a book; press Delete; confirm.
journeys.expect: The book is removed from the list.

journeys.title: lends a book and shows the borrower
journeys.steps: Open a book; press Lend; enter a Borrower name; save.
journeys.expect: The book shows the badge 'Lent to {borrower}'.

journeys.title: returns a book and clears the borrower
journeys.steps: Open a lent book; press Return.
journeys.expect: The 'Lent to {borrower}' badge disappears and the Borrower is empty.

journeys.title: filters to books currently lent out
journeys.expect: Only books with a Borrower are shown.

journeys.title: filters books by category
journeys.expect: Only books whose Category is 'Novel' are shown.

journeys.title: shows how many books are lent out
journeys.expect: It shows the count of rows where borrower is not empty.

journeys.title: preserves data across a browser refresh
journeys.steps: Add or lend a book; refresh the browser.
journeys.expect: All books, borrowers, and the 'Lent out' count remain unchanged.

omitted_patterns.reason: The idea states it is just the user on their own computer.
The idea only mentions noting the borrower and clearing it on return.
The idea asks for a single list and a lent-out filter, not text search.

assumptions: The category select is limited to Novel, Cookbook, and Reference as the examples given.
The 'Lend' action prompts for a borrower name and stores it in the Borrower field.
The 'Return' action clears the Borrower field.
